content.title: CME outage, Jefferies scrutiny, Puma takeover report
content.description:
Morning Brief host Julie Hyman tracks several of the day's top trending stock tickers. CME Group's (CME) Chicago Mercantile Exchange suffered a data outage Friday morning, disrupting futures trading. Jefferies (JEF) is in focus after the FT reported the company facing scrutiny from regulators over its First Brands ties. Puma (PUM.DE, PUMSY) shares are on the move following a Bloomberg report that China’s Anta Sports is exploring a takeover bid of the sporting goods company.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Morning Brief.
